name: Sakura Kikou ~Dorei Choukyou~
source:
Main character attends literary arts club. The whole club goes to hot springs resort. He intends to make all the girls his slaves during the trip. But he can't risk with half-baked crime - he needs to go all way through with as many girls as possible under limited time conditions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角参加文学艺术俱乐部。整个俱乐部都去温泉度假村。他打算让旅途中所有的女孩都成为他的奴隶。但他不能冒险进行不成熟的犯罪——他需要在有限的时间条件下与尽可能多的女孩一起完成任务。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
